raw_input: Promo kelas reformer pilates untuk studio baru di Bandung, target perempuan profesional yang cari rutinitas tenang.
core_message: The new reformer studio runs small morning classes and the first class is complimentary this month.

audience.description: Working women aged 27 to 45 in a mid-sized Indonesian city who want a calm, disciplined routine and judge a studio on the room, the instructor and the schedule.

mandatories: State the complimentary first class offer
